prompt: `reverse_array` runs with `rdi = 0x1000` and `rsi = 4` (four 8-byte longs). Follow the two pointers.
code:
lea rsi, [rdi + rsi*8 - 8]
.Lloop:
cmp rdi, rsi
jae .Ldone
mov rax, [rdi]
mov rcx, [rsi]
mov [rdi], rcx
mov [rsi], rax
add rdi, 8
sub rsi, 8
jmp .Lloop
.Ldone:
ret
explain: `lea` only computes an address: 0x1000 + 4*8 - 8 = 0x1018, the address of `a[3]`; it reads no memory. Each round swaps the two ends and moves the pointers 8 bytes inward. After two swaps rdi has passed rsi, so `jae` ends the loop without swapping the middle again.
